scope: Three-pass source, shared-implementation, and release review of a negative no-raster closeout. No candidate, holdout, model rerun, TIFF rewrite, or submission was performed.

passes.name: science, protocol, and provenance
checks: H65-A premise failure and no-HOLDOUT-DTI authorization boundary preserved.
Official DrivenData metric/output specification and staff pixel-exact mask clarification fetched and recorded.
GDR listing/license and USGS context checked with binary-source authentication limits explicit.
Prior art retained as prior art; no candidate described as novel or approved without evidence.

passes.name: shared output-mask implementation
checks: Shared grid writer, submission writer, and format gate preserve the sample template's NaN mask and valid zeros.
Synthetic regression tests cover matching masks, NaN inside the valid sample, and finite pixels outside.
Historical H60/H61/H63 rasters were not rewritten; their known mask mismatch now fails the current gate.

passes.name: feed, site, and final acceptance audit
checks: Current feed, landing page, source index, submission guide, and archive clearly state H65 NEGATIVE; current download NO; submit NO.
H60 submission/LATEST.txt pointer and raster hash verified intact and labelled archival only.
Static-site local links, data JSON, page assets, receipt consistency, and H65 no-raster status verified.

pytest.skip_reason: tests/test_h65.py skips the optional H62 feature-cache assertion because work/h62/feat/manifest.json is absent; no model was rerun.

site.h65_closeout: PASS — negative premise gate, no candidate/holdout/slot, H60 marker archival only

limitations: The historical portal range-rejection bytes and organizer receipt remain unavailable; the sample-mask discrepancy is not asserted as its cause.
The public leaderboard was not refreshed; its dated snapshot is retained without a fresh timestamp or score attribution.
The one skipped test depends on an absent optional feature cache, and the 59 warnings are Rasterio pending-deprecation warnings.
